goal: Independently perform final post-review QA of the Phase 4B v2 playable-art integration, including real input-driven traversal, full state transitions, configured-scale visual hierarchy, rendered frames, import/runtime stability, scope, and audit consistency.
forbidden_changes: final BK/Human Creative Owner play-feel approval
final art direction or production asset approval

verify.name: Import, smoke, and runtime pass
verify.command: godot --headless --path game --import && bash -lc 'out=$(scripts/smoke_test.sh 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR:" <<< "$out"' && bash -lc 'out=$(godot --headless --path game --scene res://scenes/main.tscn --quit-after 3 2>&1); printf "%s\n" "$out"; ! grep -E "SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR|Parse Error|Failed" <<< "$out"'

human_decision_reason: Automated traversal, state, and rendered-frame QA can prove playability readiness and configured hierarchy, but BK/Human Creative Owner still owns subjective in-motion play/feel and production-art decisions.
acceptance_criteria: QA modifies no implementation, game, script, asset, or audit-correction file.
The durable input-driven traversal test reaches SUCCESS without teleporting the player or bypassing physics.
The full state-transition regression still passes goal gate, collection, success, reset, hazard, hazard retry, and timer failure.
Rendered frames after scale adjustment show the player as the strongest foreground object, goal second, hazard/item as a matched lower tier, and background as lowest priority.
All seven approved v2 assets, single background, prototype-only status, import, smoke, runtime, and scope checks remain green.
QA reports pass/rework/blocked with no unsupported completion claim and preserves the BK play/feel gate.
notes: This fresh QA pass exists specifically to close the two-axis review findings rather than relying on the earlier state-transition-only evidence.
